responsibility: Implements loop auto-parallelization on GIMPLE by converting independent loops into OpenMP-style parallel/for regions. It analyzes candidate loops for profitability, dependence freedom, reductions, and structural constraints; rewrites loops and captured locals into the form expected by OpenMP expansion; creates helper data movement and reduction code; and updates SSA/loop state after introducing GIMPLE_OMP_PARALLEL and GIMPLE_OMP_FOR constructs, including a mode for OpenACC kernels regions.
same_name_distinction: Contains the actual loop auto-parallelization pass: candidate analysis, reduction handling, loop rewriting into GIMPLE_OMP_PARALLEL/GIMPLE_OMP_FOR, and pass registration/execution. Unlike the header, this file implements the transformation rather than just exposing a small query about parallelized functions.
